ui_bugs.issue: Heading hierarchy criterion FAILS. Inside [data-testid="home-savings-faq"] there are 1 h2 and 7 h3 elements, not 1 h3. Radix <AccordionPrimitive.Header> defaults to rendering an h3, so each of the 6 FAQ accordion triggers emits an <h3> containing a <button>. The teaser's own h3 ('Investment & Börse Schritt für Schritt verstehen') is the 7th. Fix requires passing asChild / a div wrapper on AccordionPrimitive.Header in the shared UI component (app-wide impact — left to main agent, out of test-fix scope).

At 390x844 the fixed bottom-right 'Fragen beantworten' widget visually overlaps the 'Frage stellen' CTA ([data-testid="home-faq-ask-question"]) in the 'Frage nicht gefunden' card, partially covering its label. Not a Session 58 regression but a mobile usability defect.

rca_of_the_issue: Heading-hierarchy failure RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/accordion.jsx wraps every trigger in <AccordionPrimitive.Header className="flex"> (line 15). @radix-ui/react-accordion renders AccordionPrimitive.Header as an <h3> by default, so the 6 FAQ preview items each contribute an h3 to home-savings-faq. HomeSavingsFaqSection.jsx itself is correct (a single h2 + a single h3 for the teaser). Fix belongs in the shared UI primitive, not in the section. iteration_29 false negative RCA: it reported a stale mtime (Aug 21) for HomeSavingsFaqSection.jsx; the current file is dated Aug 23 11:42 and contains all Session 58 changes, confirmed by grep -n.
